user.title: Connect Hotata Account
user.description: Enter your Hotata Smart Home app username and password. All airers linked to this account will be discovered and added automatically; no credentials are required after this step.

data.descent_time: Full descent duration in seconds (0 = disable simulation, use device position)

reconfigure.title: Re-login to Hotata
reconfigure.description: Update your Hotata Smart Home credentials (e.g. after changing your password). Optionally provide a backup account: when the primary account is rate-limited (403) by the Hotata cloud, the integration automatically fails over to the backup account and switches back once the penalty expires.

data.backup_password: Backup account password (leave empty to keep current)

error.invalid_auth: Invalid username or password. Server response: {server_message}
error.no_devices: No airer devices were found under this account.
error.phone_not_registered: This phone number is not registered with Hotata. Make sure you enter the phone number used to register in the Hotata app (WeChat users must bind a phone number and set a password in the app first). Server response: {server_message}
error.captcha_required: Login too frequent — captcha required. Please log in once via the Hotata app, then retry. Server response: {server_message}
error.account_locked: Account is locked or frozen. Contact Hotata support or try again later. Server response: {server_message}
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again later. Server response: {server_message}
error.auth_expired: Login has expired. Please log in again. Server response: {server_message}

abort.already_configured: This account has already been configured.
